# Deepvine.AI

> Deepvine.AI is a Charlotte, NC company that installs private AI knowledge
> systems for law firms, RIAs, CPA firms, and other knowledge-driven
> businesses. Deepvine connects a firm's existing systems (Slack, document
> management, CRM, finance tools, databases), backfills years of
> institutional history, and deploys a private AI that answers questions in
> Slack with source-backed citations. Unlike cloud AI tools, Deepvine runs
> in the client's own environment: data never leaves the firm's control and
> is never used to train shared models.

Legal entity: Local Labs LLC. Founded by Mitch Boraski and Adam Erwin Kerr. Contact: info@deepvine.ai

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.deepvine.ai/): What Deepvine is and how it works
- [How It Works](https://www.deepvine.ai/how-it-works/): How Deepvine.AI turns a firm's systems and history into one company memory that its team and AI agents can use
- [About](https://www.deepvine.ai/about/): Company background and founders
- [Blog](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/): Analysis on private AI, compliance, and data ownership for professional firms

## Solutions

- [Private AI for Law Firms](https://www.deepvine.ai/private-ai-for-law-firms/): Aligned with ABA Model Rule 1.6(c); client data never leaves the firm's control
- [Private AI for RIAs](https://www.deepvine.ai/private-ai-for-rias/): Books-and-records ready; client data stays inside the firm
- [Private AI for CPA Firms](https://www.deepvine.ai/private-ai-for-cpa-firms/): IRC 7216-aware deployment; client tax data never leaves
- [Private AI for Real Estate Brokerages & Teams](https://www.deepvine.ai/private-ai-for-real-estate/): Deal history, files, and institutional knowledge in one private system
- [Private AI for HOA & Community Association Managers](https://www.deepvine.ai/private-ai-for-hoa-management/): Governing documents, answered with citations
- [The Association Knowledge Audit](https://www.deepvine.ai/audit/): A $1,500 flat-fee governing-document conflicts audit for community association managers

- [RIAs and the books-and-records rule](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/ria-ai-books-and-records-rule/): SEC recordkeeping obligations and third-party AI tools
- [IRC 7216 and CPA firms](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/irc-7216-ai-tools-cpa-consent/): The tax return information consent rule and cloud AI
- [Brokerage AI and client confidentiality](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/brokerage-ai-client-confidentiality/): Private AI, data ownership, and confidentiality duties for real estate brokerages
- [The consulting firm's real product is memory](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/consulting-firm-institutional-knowledge-ai/): Institutional knowledge as competitive advantage and how private AI captures it
- [Where does your data actually go?](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/private-ai-vs-chatgpt-enterprise/): A plain-English comparison of cloud AI deployment models, data flows, and ownership
- [The institutional memory problem](https://www.deepvine.ai/blog/institutional-memory-senior-partner-retirement/): What leaves your firm when a senior partner retires, and a 24-month knowledge-capture playbook
